1170-3389-5921-5954-8345.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3752-6331-8193.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
3752-6331-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3752-6331-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Stiltzkin.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

141-3085-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-5256.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2719-5756.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-7452.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

4153-4535-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2511-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-2511-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-2511-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

1753-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1753-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1753-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3967-5961--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

457-1458-4404-6201.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-6201.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

80-550-1618-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer
80-550-1618-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Young Pyromancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-550-1618-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1283-2440-6737-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {5}, creating a token copy of it.
Barret triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Repeat.
1283-2440-6737-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4484-4668-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4668-4871-5147-5643.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4484-4668-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4668-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

57-3094-4846-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4846-7060.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2932-5220-5256-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2932-5220-5256-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2932-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

486-1978-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
486-1978-4747.description:
Cause Alena to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-2173-4779-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1894-2173-5220-6634.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2438-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2438-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

413-719-4338.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1575-4659-6748.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Repeat.

2866-4970-5751-6556--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4068-4499-4747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

222-629-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2732-4681-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide from your graveyard.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and step 3, causing target player to mill cards equal to Karmic Guide and Prowling Geistcatcher's power.
Repeat.

539-4038-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
539-4038-4878.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {G}.
Market Festival triggers, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat

190-389-4129.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, cast Back to Nature by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

628-793-2018-3524.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Gleaming Barrier.
Gleaming Barrier dies, triggering itself, it's undying ability and Luminous Broodmoth.
Resolve the first Gleaming Barrier trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Gleaming Barrier from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the second Gleaming Barrier trigger, failing to return it to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scorched Rusalka ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Gleaming Barrier.
Gleaming Barrier dies, triggering itself and it's undying ability.
Resolve the first Gleaming Barrier trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the second Gleaming Barrier trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scorched Rusalka ability from step 8, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Gleaming Barrier.
Gleaming Barrier dies, triggering itself and Luminous Broodmoth.
Resolve the first Gleaming Barrier trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Gleaming Barrier from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
 Repeat from step 6.

1939-2146-3613-4050.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Lunarch Phantom.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lunarch Phantom, adding {W}.
Because Dress Down causes Lunarch Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

229-575-5033.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Endless One by tapping it, adding {G}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1335-2440-2744.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2440-2744.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creture token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

757-4235-4657.notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
757-4235-4657.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra and pay {1}, by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

539-1606.notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
539-1606.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping itself and any other land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding one mana of any color that land can produce.
Repeat.
